gold_judge.judge: separate model, blind to silver, engine output and scores

gold_judge_calibrated.why: uncalibrated judge failed the spot-check (agreement 0.68, kappa 0.1525); the user ruled the agent does all labelling itself
gold_judge_calibrated.method: judge given the user's labelled prompts as examples; validated by 2-fold cross-validation over the user's 10 (seed 20261017), pooled
gold_judge_calibrated.on_miss: gold is still the calibrated judge's labels on the 40 plus the user's 10, but every gold number is reported UNVALIDATED and no gold bar line may read PASS
